overview.title: Program Overview
overview.name: Project Name: DO DREAM TWO-GETHER International
overview.type: Type: Mid-to-Long-term Spiritual Training Program for Christian Youth Worldwide
overview.target: Target: Christian youth of churches worldwide (20-30s, foreign nationals)
overview.duration: Duration: 3 months (85 days, within 90-day visa limit)

purpose.title: Our Purpose
purpose.description: To invite Christian youth worldwide for intensive education and systematic spiritual training on the essence of the Christian faith, nurturing the next generation of church leaders.

items.title: Spiritual Training
items.desc: Basic Christian faith, spiritual training, worship, community activities, and leadership training.

items.title: Korean Language
items.desc: Basic Korean conversation, reading, and writing education.

items.title: Cultural Experience
items.desc: Visiting Korean tourist attractions, experiencing Korean history and traditional culture.

effects.title: Expected Effects
items: Spiritual maturity and leadership capacity building for Christian youth worldwide
Formation of an international faith network
